frame_task_failed: Image task {task} failed. Manually regenerate its card to start a new task. {reason}
frame_submission_unknown: The image submission result is unknown. Resubmission is blocked to avoid duplicate charges. Check the task in APIMart before restoring its task ID or clearing the uncertainty marker: {path}
frame_task_pending: Frame task {task} has no confirmed terminal result. Continue the remaining storyboard frames to query this task before editing or starting another paid generation.
frame_operation: Finish or resume the current film/storyboard operation before regenerating a frame from its card.
continue_operation: There is no storyboard ready to continue. Finish the current operation first.
frame_done: Frame {frame} updated. Other frames were not regenerated. Explicitly continue the film to update the video.
frames_ready: Storyboard ready. Preview and edit individual frames, then continue the film when satisfied.
env_symlink: The local .env is a symlink. Edit it directly or save for this session only.
film_invalid: The original CLI cannot load film.json: {detail}
instance: A workbench service is already running for this repository. Use that page or stop the service before changing ports.
number: must be a finite number between {low} and {high}
missing_image: Reference image not found: {path}. Upload and bind an image, or check its path relative to the repository root.
image: Invalid or unsupported image: {path}. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP.
keys: Live generation needs: {names}. Configure keys or use offline demo mode.
ffmpeg: Live generation requires ffmpeg and ffprobe. Install them and restart the workbench.
busy: A task is already running. Wait for it to finish.
output: Output directory already exists and is not empty: {path}. Choose a new directory, or resume the original task from history.
output_reserved: Cannot use the workbench internal directory for output: {path}
resume: Only failed or interrupted tasks can be resumed.
alive: The original process is still running (PID {pid}). Wait before resuming to avoid duplicate submissions.
origin: Local same-origin requests only. Use the workbench page.
upload: Select 1–9 images, up to 32 MB per upload.
exit: Task exited with code {code}. See logs. Failed tasks can resume with the original inputs.
interrupted: The local service stopped before completion was confirmed. Cloud tasks may still run; resume the original task to check.
demo_start: Offline demo: no network, no models, no charges.
demo_no_video: ffmpeg / ffprobe not found. Only plan, storyboard placeholders and report will be generated; no video.
demo_video: The video contains static DEMO placeholders, solely for testing playback and downloads.
reference_upload_missing: The uploaded file for "{slot}" is missing or invalid. Please upload it again.
too_many_references: Total reference images ({count}) exceed the maximum of {limit}. Merge multiple characters into a shared reference sheet or reduce references.
review_request: Confirmation requires approved=true and the current storyboard version.
review_changed: The frames changed or are not ready. Refresh and review the current images.
review_required: Confirm all current storyboard images or the script plan before generating video.
output_root_missing: Output root is missing or is not a folder: {path}. Select a folder again.
output_picker_title: Choose a folder for storyboards and videos
output_picker_unsupported: This folder picker supports a workbench running locally on Windows or macOS.
output_picker_timeout: Folder selection timed out. Click Choose folder again.
output_picker_failed: Could not open the system folder picker: {detail}
output_picker_busy: A folder picker is already open. Complete or cancel that selection first.
server_started: Workbench ready at {url}. Keep this window open; press Ctrl+C to exit.
segment_operation: Finish or resume the current task before regenerating a segment or assembling the film from its results page.
segment_number: Invalid segment number {number}; this film has {count} segments.
segment_changed: Segment {number} changed or its file is missing. Refresh and try again.
segment_prompt: Segment {number} has no saved video prompt and cannot be regenerated independently.
segment_ffmpeg: Segment operations require ffmpeg and ffprobe. Install them and restart the workbench.
segment_media: The video is missing or unreadable: {path}
segment_done: Segment {number} updated. Other clips are unchanged. Preview it, then reassemble the full video.
assembly_missing: Some video segments are missing or not yet generated. The film cannot be assembled.
assembly_changed: Video segment versions changed. Refresh before starting a new assembly.
frame_prompt_unchanged: This frame failed content review. Edit its prompt before manually regenerating it.
frames_partial: All other frames have been processed. {count} failed frames are saved for manual repair. Complete the storyboard before generating video.
segment_publishing: Segment {number} publication is uncommitted. Resume publication first; this does not generate again.
segment_prompt_changed: Segment {number} prompt version changed. Keep your draft and review the current version before retrying.
segment_locked: Segment {number} has an unresolved task or unknown submission. Resume the original task or verify acceptance manually; a new prompt cannot replace it.
segment_terminal: Segment {number} reached terminal failure. Resume will not pay again; explicitly start a new attempt from the card.
segment_attempt_failed: Segment {number} attempt failed (phase {phase}, revision {revision}). Previous video and prompts remain available; follow the recovery guidance.
segment_recovery_manual_check: Acceptance is unknown. Verify the task with the provider and restore its ID before proceeding; duplicate submission is blocked.
segment_recovery_new_revision: The remote task has terminally failed. Explicitly start a new attempt after editing; new charges apply.
segment_recovery_resume: Resume this attempt or finish publication without creating a new generation task.
segment_recovery_edit_prompt: No generation task was accepted. Check configuration or edit the prompt and retry; completed text requests may have been charged.
segment_internal: A local error occurred for segment {number}. Correlation ID {instance}; keep your draft and check the task log.
segment_rewrite_done: Segment {number} English prompt updated and saved; existing video was preserved without calling the video API.
segments_rewrite_done: Converted English prompts for {count} segment(s); no video generation was triggered.
segments_rewrite_none: All segments already have up-to-date English prompts; nothing to rewrite.
segment_snapshot_changed: Clip versions are changing. Refresh the results; your draft is preserved.
comfy_offline: Remote ComfyUI is offline. Start Colab A100 from the top runtime status card (or start your ComfyUI tunnel) and wait until it is Online before generating video.
comfy_starting: Remote ComfyUI is offline; Colab A100 startup has been triggered automatically. Complete Google Drive authorization if prompted in the top runtime card and retry once Online.
comfy_auth_failed: Remote ComfyUI tunnel rejected authentication (HTTP {code}). Check that COMFYUI_API_KEY matches .comfyui_api_key.
